issue.title: Remove stale Symvision exemptions for sase-bj.3
issue.description: Discovered while running the mandatory just check for sase-bn. Symvision rejects the Justfile exemptions sase-bj.3(CommitMessagePolicy) and sase-bj.3(CommitSubject) because bead sase-bj.3 is already closed. Remove the stale --epic-symbol entries and clean up or otherwise resolve the two symbols according to the Symvision workflow.
